note: Golden conformance vectors for reconcile_ucp_checkout_totals. Derived from the Universal Commerce Protocol schema and issue material (github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp, commit 7a5daa55313f8b468aba76caf01fb76851d37f84 (tag v2026-08-25), Apache-2.0): flower_shop_checkout_reconciled adapts the repo flower_shop reference storefront example; negative_total_cart and the refund vectors exercise issues #1025 and #1026; boundary_2p53 and fractional_quantity_scale2 exercise the integer amount and quantity-unit rules. output_payload values are exactly what compute() returns (golden parity, kernel_generated by construction). human_sign_off: PENDING (builder-authored 2026-11-03, UCP-TOTALS-1).

vectors.name: flower_shop_checkout_reconciled
vectors.description: Derives from the UCP repo flower_shop reference storefront example: a 7000 cart with WELCOME20 (-700), fulfillment 495, zero tax and fee, total 6795 reconciles and the discount extension is reported with its code.

discount_attribution.note: applied discounts come from the dev.ucp.shopping.discount extension; code is omitted for automatic discounts (discount.json). Reported, not judged.

output_payload.spec_basis: UCP 2026-08-25 schemas (tag v2026-08-25 of github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp, Apache-2.0): common/types/totals.json + total.json + amount.json + signed_amount.json, common/types/unit.json + quantity_unit.json, shopping/types/item.json + unit_price.json + adjustment.json, shopping/discount.json; issues #1025 (negative total) and #1026 (order discount attribution)
output_payload.scope_note: Arithmetic-consistency reconcile only: the node recomputes identities (price x quantity steps / 10^scale, line-subtotal roll-up, totals breakdown sum, refund bound) and checks the schema sign rules; it never judges whether a tax, fee or discount AMOUNT itself was computed correctly, because UCP publishes no tax or rounding algorithm. At most one rounding happens per line, under the caller-declared policy (default half_even), and the output names the rule applied.

vectors.name: negative_total_cart
vectors.description: Issue #1025 case: an over-applied discount drives the authoritative total to -500. The document is schema-valid and reconciles (subtotal 2000 + discount -2500 = total -500); the negative total is reported informationally, not flagged.

discount_attribution.note: the document carries no discounts.applied[] extension data

notes: NEGATIVE_TOTAL: the declared total is negative; UCP issue #1025 records that the total entry carries no sign bound and such documents pass schema validation. Reported informationally, not a mismatch.
